name: starter-flame
unmodelled: Embers Feed the Hearth (25 % of each Burn tick returned as linh lực) is approximated by gain_on_hit_pct 0.6 and regen_bonus_pp 3 (identity id: embers-feed-the-hearth); its true trigger is not modelled
Embers Feed the Hearth's closing cost (direct Fire hits deal 15 % less) is not applied, so direct damage here is overstated by up to 15 %
First Move (first art free) and Fire art cost nodes are folded into art_cost_pct 15
Kindled Wound (L5 +15 on Fire parts vs a target bearing your Burn) is a guard the simulator cannot model: applied as always-on L5 15, a slight overstatement because Burn lands with the first art
Xich Diem Dia Quyet technique bonuses (linh_luc_pct 12, tam_ma_resist_pct 8) and the root purity are not checked beyond purity.fire; the technique's L2 share is folded into layers L2 40
Burn ticks are modelled by the simulator's fire debuff stacks; their linh luc return is the Embers approximation above
